The 'Try again' button (#retry) inside .optional-retry {display:none} remains in the focusable nodes array, making it the last focusable element. When Shift+Tab is pressed from the first element (#email), focus attempts to move to #retry (index 3), but since it's display:none, focus stays on #email instead of wrapping to #close (index 2).",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify getFocusableNodes() in micromodal.js to additionally filter out elements that have zero rendered dimensions (width/height 0), which excludes CSS display:none elements like #retry while preserving all visibly rendered dialog controls.",

    {
      "path": "micromodal.js",
      "sha256": "9c7626d051e145d64057073c98fd94c49ca4a23257c277ba4fddafdb2279f4e9",
      "before": "    getFocusableNodes () {\n      const nodes = this.modal.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS)\n      return Array.from(nodes).filter(node => !node.closest('[hidden]') && !node.hasAttribute('hidden'))\n    }",
      "after": "    getFocusableNodes () {\n      const nodes = this.modal.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS)\n      return Array.from(nodes).filter(node => {\n        if (node.closest('[hidden]') || node.hasAttribute('hidden')) return false\n        const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect()\n        return rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0\n      })\n    }"
    }
  ],

  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Shift+Tab from #email moves focus to #close (step 3 passes)",
    "Tab from #close moves focus to #email (step 6 passes)",
    "Full Tab cycle: #email → #confirm → #close → #email (steps 4-7 pass)",
    "Enter on #confirm closes dialog, shows receipt, returns focus to #open (step 9 passes)",
    "All functional invariants (receipt text, data attributes, visibility) hold"
  ]
}
